projects.taglineZh: Leopard’s Hill 路 84 户商住一体封闭社区 · 建设中。
projects.taglineEn: A mixed-use gated community rising on Leopard’s Hill Road.
projects.location: Leopard’s Hill Road, opposite Mukamunya Estate, Lusaka
projects.descriptionZh: 位于 Mukamunya Estate 对面、卢萨卡增长最快的 Leopard’s Hill 走廊,占地 16 英亩:84 栋优质住宅与 39 间临街商铺组成自足型社区,生活、购物、社交在一个大门之内完成。周边有 Monkey Pools、Glynview Events 与 Cross Park。
projects.descriptionEn: Opposite Mukamunya Estate on Leopard’s Hill Road — Lusaka’s fastest-growing corridor — Oasis Crown spans 16 acres with 84 premium homes and 39 retail shops: a self-sufficient neighbourhood where you live, shop and connect without leaving the gate. Monkey Pools, Glynview Events and Cross Park are all nearby.

keyFeatures.zh: 84 栋优质住宅 + 39 间临街商铺,商住一体
Mukamunya Estate 对面,高速成长走廊
keyFeatures.en: Opposite Mukamunya Estate on a fast-growing corridor

keyFeatures.zh: 自足型社区:生活、购物、社交一门之内
keyFeatures.en: Self-sufficient: live, shop and connect inside the gate

projects.taglineZh: Ibex Hill 二街 78 户封闭社区 · 一年售罄。
projects.taglineEn: 78-home gated community on 2nd Street, Ibex Hill — sold out in one year.
projects.descriptionZh: 位于卢萨卡最炙手可热的 Ibex Hill 二街,占地 10.3 英亩:78 栋住宅,配套商业中心、酒吧与泳池区,一个完整而有活力的社区。距前总统官邸 800 米、美国大使馆 4.2 公里、Ibex Mall 1.2 公里、Legacy Resort 6 公里。项目建成并在一年内全部售罄。
projects.descriptionEn: Set on 10.3 acres along 2nd Street in Ibex Hill — one of Lusaka’s most sought-after addresses — Oasis Miracle delivers 78 homes with a shopping complex, bar and swimming area: a complete, vibrant community. The former President’s House is 800 m away, the American Embassy 4.2 km, Ibex Mall 1.2 km and Legacy Resort 6 km. Built and fully sold out within one year.

keyFeatures.zh: 78 栋住宅 + 商业中心 + 酒吧 + 泳池区
keyFeatures.en: 78 houses + shopping complex + bar + swimming area

keyFeatures.zh: 距前总统官邸 800 米,美国大使馆 4.2 公里
keyFeatures.en: 800 m from the former President’s House, 4.2 km from the American Embassy

keyFeatures.zh: 建成并于一年内全部售罄
keyFeatures.en: Built and sold out in just one year

projects.taglineZh: State Lodge 区 19 席专属大宅 · 即将推出。
projects.taglineEn: 19 exclusive estates in the State Lodge area — coming soon.
projects.location: State Lodge Area, Lusaka (22.8 km from CBD)
projects.descriptionZh: 坐落于卢萨卡久负盛名的 State Lodge 区域,距 CBD 22.8 公里:仅 19 席专属宅邸,单户居住空间 1,000–3,000 平方米,为追求极致私密与空间的人而设计。专属、宽绰、毫不妥协的隐私。
projects.descriptionEn: In Lusaka’s prestigious State Lodge area, 22.8 km from the CBD: just 19 exclusive homes with 1,000–3,000 sqm of living space each — designed for those who demand the finest. Exclusive, spacious, uncompromising privacy. Your private estate awaits.

keyFeatures.zh: 全社区仅 19 席,极致稀缺
keyFeatures.en: Only 19 homes in the entire estate
1,000–3,000 sqm of living space per home

keyFeatures.zh: 毫不妥协的私密性与空间感

projects.taglineZh: 卢萨卡 CBD 旁的天际线公寓 · 建设中，2028 年开盘。
projects.taglineEn: Skyline apartments next to Lusaka CBD · under construction, opening 2028.
projects.propertyTypeZh: 高层精装公寓 · 1 卧 / 2 卧 / 3 卧
projects.descriptionZh:
「荣耀」是集团首次进入卢萨卡 CBD 周边高层住宅市场的代表项目，240 套精装公寓覆盖 1 / 2 / 3 卧多户型，主力面向年轻专业人士、外派员工与短期投资人。

项目在 Cathedral Hill 拔地而起，景观视野直接覆盖 Independence Avenue、Lusaka Showgrounds 与机场方向。预计 2028 年全期交付，2026 年开放预约。
projects.descriptionEn:
Honor is the group's first move into Lusaka's CBD-fringe high-rise residential market — 240 furnished apartments across 1/2/3-bed layouts, designed for young professionals, expat employees and short-stay investors.

Rising on Cathedral Hill with sightlines across Independence Avenue, the Lusaka Showgrounds and the airport corridor. Full delivery 2028; reservations open 2026.

keyFeatures.zh: 240 套精装公寓 · 1/2/3 卧多户型
高层视野直达 CBD 与机场方向
keyFeatures.en: Skyline views across CBD and airport corridor

keyFeatures.zh: 面向年轻专业人士与短租投资人
keyFeatures.en: Targeted at young professionals and short-stay investors

keyFeatures.zh: 底商配套：餐饮、便利店、共享办公
2026 开放预约 · 2028 全期交付
